dossier.identity: resonance operator who accelerates allies with upbeat waves and breaks enemy formations with feedback from a deployed resonator pylon, backed by dorsal tendrils and an echo drone
dossier.selectionRationale: chosen as the acoustic control operator: ally acceleration in a cone, a delayed shock burst that silences, and a resonance passive that repeats the empowered cast, distinct from eider's haste field, lyra's speaker and echo's relay. the harmonic fork kit uses its own three companion models (owner decision F5).
dossier.weaponConcept: harmonic fork (gigantic sonic rifle that channels coherent waveforms into healing and disruptive resonance: resonator core, tuning-fork frame, membrane array, dampener unit and emitter rail)

lore.backstory: former session musician from the sound-district towers who stole a prototype tuning-fork cannon when the district was rezoned to silence. the pylon she plants was the tower's resonance mast; the tendrils on her back are what remained of her stage rig.
lore.syndicateRecord: wanted for a thirty-second feedback burst that cleared a corporate auditorium and for refusing to return the rezoning board's microphones.
lore.psychProfile: playful, intuitive and rhythm-obsessed; hears every fight as a song and will not leave a squad out of tune.
lore.combatQuote: “i'll keep you in tune. voices make a brighter tomorrow.”

signature.stock: Plants a resonator pylon (carrier: 300 hp, shootable) up to 9 m (900 cm) away that screams 0.5 s (15 ticks) later: enemies within 2 m (200 cm) take 130 damage and 25 stability. Cost 38 · windup 0.5 s (15 ticks) · cooldown 20 s (600 ticks).
signature.interpretation: Numbers follow the roster conventions and extend the concept sheet; every guessed field is listed as a hypothesis in the form behaviour. Geometry is the authored illustration profile, not an executable collision bake.

payloadUnits.damage: points per hit or pulse; sequence describes splitting
payloadUnits.statusAmount: percentage points unless a state definition specifies otherwise

counterplay: Shoot the pylon before it screams; leave the ring during the 0.5 s delay; cleanse or outrun the silence.

forms.name: feedback
forms.description: Plants a resonator pylon (carrier: 300 hp, shootable) up to 9 m (900 cm) away that screams 0.5 s (15 ticks) later: enemies within 2 m (200 cm) take 130 damage and 25 stability. Cost 38 · windup 0.5 s (15 ticks) · cooldown 20 s (600 ticks).

forms.name: dampened burst
forms.description: The scream also silences enemies in the ring for 1 s (30 ticks).

forms.name: triple shock
forms.description: The scream becomes three expanding shock rings at 2 m, 4 m and 6 m (200, 400 and 600 cm), 0.5 s (15 ticks) apart, dealing 100%, 80% and 60% damage; only the first silences.

iconFamily.subject: a bold tuning fork standing on a single chunky resonator pylon
iconFamily.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: one base raster concept for a game ability icon, to be traced into SVG. Character: Opal. Theme: in tune. Subject: a bold tuning fork standing on a single chunky resonator pylon. Centered compact square silhouette, fills 82% of canvas. Flat solid black monochromatic ink on genuinely transparent background. Exceptionally bold clean outer contour, broad shapes and large negative-space gaps. Recognizable at 24 to 30 pixels. No tiny details, thin lines, text, badges, borders, HUD elements, colored accents, gradients, shadows, textures or 3D. ONE original base emblem, not a sheet or variants. All four subsequent ability variations must keep this same identifiable theme.
iconFamily.method: built-in image generation, then silhouette tracing, then four SVG variations
